plainText:
Oluolu (Japanese: オルオル ʻOluʻolu) is a recurring character in . He is a famous Pokémon Base player from Melemele Island who plays for the (Japanese: コイキング Koiking). He is also a graduate of the Pokémon School.

==History==
Oluolu debuted in Pulling Out the Pokémon Base Pepper!. saw 's excitement after watching one of Oluolu's Pokémon Base games on television. As a result, he and Principal Oak arranged a Pokémon Base match for the of the Pokémon School and their Pokémon, with the three adults commentating the match. When arrived, with Jessie wanting Oluolu's autograph, he agreed to participate in a game between the students and the evil trio. Just when it seemed like Team Rocket was about to win, Oluolu had his perform the Z-Move , allowing the school team to win the match. Despite Team Rocket losing, Oluolu still offered Jessie his autograph as thanks for the good game, but before she could take it, showed up and carried the trio away.

In Night of a Thousand Poses!, Oluolu was seen playing Pokémon Base on TV. In The Dex Can't Help It!, he was playing Pokémon Base with a when ended up on TV.

In Battle Royal 151!, Oluolu was among the 151 Trainers taking part in the Battle Royal preliminary round of the Manalo Conference, which he entered with his Snorlax. He ended up losing and being eliminated from the tournament.

==Character==
Much like Samson Oak, Oluolu has a habit of making Pokémon gags, accompanied by a visual imitation of the Pokémon in question.

===Pokémon Base===
As a player in the Pokémon Base professional league, Oluolu has achieved the following titles:

===Pokémon League===
Oluolu has competed in the following Pokémon League Conferences:
